privacy.title: Before you start
privacy.subtitle: Privacy notice · Law 18-07
privacy.heading: What Minhajna keeps, and where
privacy.intro: A short notice before first use, always available in Help.
privacy.phoneText: Lists, roll calls, marks and record books are stored encrypted on the device. No account or internet is needed.
privacy.leaveText: This version does not connect to the internet, and does not ask for permission to. Pupils’ data never goes into the phone’s cloud backups.
privacy.neverText: No health, disability, religion or photos of pupils, no information about parents, and no addresses. An absence is excused or not, with no reason given.
privacy.trackingText: No ads, no analytics, no record of hours or location, and no crash reports.
privacy.publisherText: The open-source Minhajna project. This version connects to none of its servers.
privacy.rightsText: To see what the project holds about you, and to have it corrected and deleted within 10 days.

connections.title: What the app connects to, and why
connections.none: This version does not connect to the internet: it asks for no permission to, and sends and receives nothing.
connections.source: The source code link in Licences opens only after you confirm. Your browser opens it outside the app, with no record or identifier.
connections.packSource: A pack’s source address, in its details, opens only after you are asked, and the question names the site. Your browser opens it outside the app, with no record or identifier.
connections.errorReport: A plan-error report is shown in full, and leaves the phone only when you share it and pick the app that sends it. The app adds nothing about your classes or pupils, nor your name unless you type it.
connections.register: Any connection the project adds is listed in the NETWORK.md file of the source code, with what is sent and why, before it reaches the app.

planLayers.title: Plan layers
planLayers.intro: A class’s plan is built in layers, from the bottom up. Each layer is operations over the ones below, not a copy: order, merges, splits, session counts, items left out and added. So every fix to the pack reaches every class.

empty.district: No district distribution for this class’s pack. One comes in a file signed by the Minhajna curators, opened from “Import a layer”.
empty.school: No school layer for this class’s pack. The subject coordinator shares one as a file or QR code, opened from “Import a layer”.

planLayers.unverified: Came from {{by}}. The sender is not verified.
planLayers.onLine: Applied to {{class}}. Each class has its own switch.
planLayers.offLine: Not applied to {{class}}: it follows the layers below.
planLayers.termTwo: Its operations fall in terms {{first}} and {{second}}.
planLayers.termAll: Its operations fall in all three terms.
planLayers.noneOn: No layer applied: my changes sit on the pack
planLayers.foot: No layer is ever called “official”, even one from an inspector or a school. Switching a layer off brings its items back as they are below it, and leaves recorded sessions as they are.
planLayers.importIntro: A district layer, in a file signed by the Minhajna curators, or a school layer from the subject coordinator, as a file or QR code. Taking a layer in applies it to no class: each class has its own switch in Plan layers.
planLayers.held: You already took this layer in.
planLayers.clash: You already took in another layer with this ID, so this one cannot be taken in. Ask its sender for a new copy.
planLayers.otherPack: This layer is for another pack than {{class}}’s. Open it from the plan of a class that follows that pack.

problems.payload: Something in the layer does not fit its format, or it is for another country.
problems.level: A district layer only comes in a signed file, and a school layer never comes signed.
problems.signer: The key that signed the file does not sign packs or their layers.
problems.input: The file or code could not be read.

planLayers.refused: The class’s layer could not be changed now.

rules.title: Counting rules
rules.intro: No official text settles these rules, so they are settings. Totals are worked out again when they change; recorded absences do not change.
rules.startContext: Possible attendance is counted from this day
rules.unitHalfNote: An absence in the morning or the afternoon counts 1, a whole day 2. Lateness never counts as an absence.
rules.unitSession: Counting unit: the half-day, with the roll taken each session
rules.unitSessionNote: Missing one or more of my sessions in a morning or an afternoon counts 1, a whole day 2. Lateness never counts as an absence.
rules.countSeminars: Count training days and teaching seminars in possible attendance
rules.countNotHeld: Count sessions not held in possible attendance
